squawks.headline: US envoy Witkoff expects to announce today the date of a three-way meeting on Ukraine
squawks.detail: Interfax reports that US envoy Witkoff expects to give the date of a tripartite meeting on Ukraine later today. Separate reports say he hopes the new round of talks will include European representatives.

squawks.headline: Putin says leaving 'grey zones' in place would make any agreement unstable and rule out lasting peace
squawks.detail: Russian President Putin said during talks with US envoys that keeping grey zones would undermine any agreements on Ukraine and prevent a lasting peace.

squawks.headline: US envoy Witkoff hopes Putin talks lead to a new round of trilateral Ukraine talks with Europeans taking part
squawks.detail: US envoy Witkoff said he hoped a new round of trilateral talks, with European participation, could be announced after the negotiations with Putin in Moscow.

squawks.headline: Putin says Russia wants the US to work out with Europe whether they want peace or war
squawks.detail: Russian President Putin said Russia would like Washington to work with European allies to decide whether they are seeking peace or war over Ukraine, according to reports. The remarks follow his comments earlier in the day on foreign troops in Ukraine.

squawks.headline: Putin says any foreign troops in Ukraine would be a legitimate target for Russia and calls their presence unacceptable
squawks.detail: Interfax reports that President Putin also said Russia has never opposed dialogue with Europe and wants peace in Ukraine to be permanent. He said Russia controls Kostiantynivka and needs five days to clear mines there, and proposed that Russian and Ukrainian ombudsmen organise the humanitarian mission.

squawks.headline: Putin proposes a humanitarian mission from Kostiantynivka modelled on earlier cooperation with Ukraine over Oleshky
squawks.detail: At his Kremlin meeting with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner, President Putin described humanitarian cooperation with Ukraine over Oleshky as positive. He proposed organising a similar mission from Kostiantynivka, according to reports.

squawks.headline: Putin says Russia recognises only one demarcation line with Ukraine, the state border
squawks.detail: Russian President Putin said that for Russia the only demarcation line with Ukraine is the state border. He spoke as the Kremlin's talks with US envoys continued.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner says Washington has begun talks with European partners on the continent's security architecture
squawks.detail: US envoy Kushner said the US has started discussing Europe's security architecture with European partners. He also said the US sees a strong European wish to take part in negotiations and end the war in Ukraine, Interfax reported.

squawks.headline: Riksbank's Bunge says the policy rate will likely need to rise over the coming year, with gradual changes important
squawks.detail: Riksbank policymaker Bunge said a rate rise is likely to be needed over the coming year. She added that it is important for monetary policy to change gradually.

squawks.headline: US envoy Witkoff says planned Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap shows progress towards a settlement
squawks.detail: Speaking around his Kremlin talks with Putin, US envoy Witkoff said the Russian and Ukrainian delegations worked effectively in Abu Dhabi and that Europeans were kept informed but did not sit at the negotiating table. He said he will brief Zelenskiy on the talks.

squawks.headline: US envoy Witkoff tells Putin meeting the Abu Dhabi contacts were held in a positive atmosphere
squawks.detail: Witkoff and Kushner are meeting Putin, with Russian officials Medinsky, Dmitriev and Ushakov also present. Reports say Putin told the envoys it was important for him to hear their assessment of the Abu Dhabi talks, and that he noted the success of humanitarian efforts in Ukraine.

squawks.headline: European Council President Costa says next week will be a decisive test of whether Russia is willing to end the war
squawks.detail: European Council President António Costa made the remarks in a speech in Dublin on Thursday. He did not give further detail on the timing.

squawks.headline: Putin thanks Trump through US envoys for helping Russia-Ukraine contacts as Kremlin talks with Witkoff and Kushner begin
squawks.detail: According to Interfax and other reports, Putin met US envoys Witkoff and Kushner at the Kremlin. He asked them to pass his thanks to Trump for facilitating contacts between Russia and Ukraine and pointed to progress on the humanitarian track.

squawks.headline: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico immediately unless it stops migrant caravans
squawks.detail: US President Trump said tariffs on Mexico would be doubled straight away if Mexico does not stop migrant caravans.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy asks for energy support for Ukraine now and through the winter, citing equipment destroyed by Russia
squawks.detail: Speaking in Dublin, Ukraine's President Zelenskiy said Ukraine needs energy support now and through the winter. He said his team has a list of the equipment it needs to replace after Russian attacks destroyed it.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy calls US approach of discussing a new security order with Russia strange and wants Europe at the table
squawks.detail: Speaking in Dublin, Ukraine's president said Europe should be a regular part of negotiations with Russia and that he will hold talks with US representatives later on Thursday. He also said Russia treats energy as a battlefield each winter and that Ukraine needs air defence interceptors.

squawks.headline: NATO's Rutte says US, European and Ukrainian positions were closely aligned at the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: NATO Secretary General Rutte also said Europe and the US reached agreement in January on the outline of security guarantees, and that this work is complete.

squawks.headline: NATO's Rutte calls Abu Dhabi talks news positive but says whether Russia will cooperate will be judged later
squawks.detail: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte described the outcome of the Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine as positive and said Russia's willingness to cooperate would be assessed later. He also said Ukraine needs to be as strong as possible, both in the fighting and in negotiations with Russia.

squawks.headline: France's Macron says Europe needs a clear, united vision of what it wants for Ukraine
squawks.detail: French President Macron said on Thursday that Europe must have a clear and shared position on its goals for Ukraine. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Iran says reviewing an exit from the nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty is now a national demand
squawks.detail: Iran described its review of withdrawing from the NPT as having become a national demand, Fars news agency reported. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Iran says it is reviewing withdrawal from the nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, calling the move an unavoidable necessity
squawks.detail: Iran's Fars news agency reported the statement. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: All 71 economists in a poll expect the ECB to raise its deposit rate to 2.75% in December
squawks.detail: In a poll of economists, all 71 respondents expect the ECB to raise its deposit rate to 2.75% in December, up from 64 of 73 in the October poll. 46 of the 71 see the deposit rate peaking at 2.75%, while 25 see a peak of 3.00%.

squawks.headline: Germany's Merz says Europeans must be involved in Ukraine talks and expects Putin to agree to give them a seat
squawks.detail: German Chancellor Merz said it was important that Russia is willing to engage in talks, and that he expects Putin to agree that Europeans should have a seat at the table. He also said he sees a good chance of concluding EU budget talks before the end of the year.

squawks.headline: EU's von der Leyen says the next Russia sanctions package and a Ukraine financing proposal will come before the new year
squawks.detail: European Commission President von der Leyen said the Commission will present its next sanctions package and a proposal on financial rules for Ukraine before next year. She also said she strongly welcomes the peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: EU foreign policy chief Kallas says she would very much like Britain to return to Europe
squawks.detail: Kaja Kallas, the EU's foreign policy chief, said she would strongly welcome Britain rejoining Europe. Earlier on the blotter, Chancellor Healey said any UK deal with the EU must bring benefits greater than its trade-offs.

squawks.headline: NIESR raises its UK fourth-quarter GDP growth projection to 0.4% from 0.2%
squawks.detail: NIESR's GDP tracker confirms that UK GDP grew 0.7% in Q3, up from 0.5% in Q2, and now projects 0.4% growth in Q4 2026, revised up from last month's 0.2%. The institute says the Bank of England should stay focused on second-round effects.

squawks.headline: EU's Kallas says Russia is showing no goodwill and that the focus in Ukraine should be on a ceasefire
squawks.detail: EU foreign policy chief Kallas said the EU sees no goodwill from Russia and that attention in Ukraine should be on a ceasefire. She also said European Council President Costa and the High Representative should represent the EU.

squawks.headline: India's consumer price inflation reaches 6.09% in October, above the 5.93% forecast
squawks.detail: India's government says consumer prices rose 6.09% year on year in October. A Reuters poll had forecast 5.93%.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey says any UK deal with the EU must bring benefits greater than its trade-offs
squawks.detail: The UK Chancellor made the comment when asked about a deal with the EU. No further detail or market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation says UK GDP has grown 1.9% over the first nine months of the year
squawks.detail: Following the third-quarter GDP release, the Resolution Foundation said UK output rose 1.9% over the first nine months of the year. It said this puts the UK on track to be the second-fastest growing economy in the G7.

squawks.headline: Russia's Ryabkov says the US is committed to resolving the Ukraine conflict
squawks.detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Ryabkov said Washington is committed to finding a solution to the war in Ukraine, according to reports. He also said that NATO's Supreme Commander Grinkevich being at the Abu Dhabi talks made the discussion of European security more professional.

squawks.headline: Iran's IRGC Navy says a third tanker has exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine
squawks.detail: The IRGC Navy's public relations office said the tanker had breached its rules for the Strait of Hormuz, according to reports. The statement follows its earlier claim that two supertankers exploded in the strait overnight.

squawks.headline: US envoy Witkoff hopes the Abu Dhabi trilateral talks bring Ukraine peace a step closer
squawks.detail: Reports say US envoy Witkoff expressed hope after the US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, and Kremlin aide Ushakov set out what Putin, Witkoff and Kushner will discuss. The same reports say military and energy facilities in Ukraine have been hit.

squawks.headline: Russia's Ryabkov says US and European approaches differ sharply and bringing Europe into Ukraine talks could derail progress
squawks.detail: Russian media report that Deputy Foreign Minister Ryabkov said the United States and Europe take very different approaches to the Ukraine negotiations. He said that involving European countries could undermine constructive efforts.

squawks.headline: Gassco extends reduced capacity at Norway's Troll gas field by one day to Saturday
squawks.detail: Norwegian gas system operator Gassco says the capacity reduction at the Troll field will now last one extra day, until Saturday. No figure for the size of the reduction was given.

squawks.headline: Russia's Ryabkov says Putin will set out Russia's position to US negotiators, leaving Washington to persuade European allies
squawks.detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Ryabkov says Putin will give Russia's position to the American negotiators, after which it falls to the United States to bring its European allies round. The remarks follow US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: Russia's Ryabkov says uncontrolled escalation should be avoided after the negotiations
squawks.detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said escalation should not be allowed to get out of control following the negotiations. He spoke after the US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: Russia's Ryabkov denies that the Abu Dhabi negotiations have restored trust between the parties
squawks.detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Ryabkov said it was wrong to describe trust between the sides as restored after the Abu Dhabi talks. Earlier, US envoy Kushner had described the talks as an important breakthrough.

squawks.headline: Turkey lifts its end-2027 inflation estimate to 21% from 15%
squawks.detail: Turkey has revised its inflation estimate for the end of 2027 up to 21%, from 15% previously, according to a market news feed.

squawks.headline: France's European affairs minister says sanctions on Iran will be tightened after a cyber attack involving fridges
squawks.detail: France's European affairs minister Haddad said sanctions against Iran would be strengthened in response to a cyber attack that targeted fridges. No further details or market reaction were reported.

squawks.headline: France's European affairs minister says the EU will approve further sanctions on Russia on Monday
squawks.detail: France's European affairs minister, Haddad, said EU approval of a further package of sanctions on Russia is due on Monday.

squawks.headline: China's commerce ministry says Beijing and Washington are in close contact on tariff cuts, trade and investment
squawks.detail: China's commerce ministry said it is in close communication with the US over tariff reduction, trade and investment, and on interaction between Xi and Trump. It added that China is willing to keep strengthening cooperation and to manage differences properly.

squawks.headline: UK goods trade deficit widens to 22.29bn in September, wider than the 19.2bn forecast
squawks.detail: The September goods trade deficit was 22.29bn against 18.01bn the previous month, with the non-EU deficit at 8.99bn. Third-quarter business investment rose 0.4% on the quarter, in line with forecasts, and Q3 GDP grew 1.9% year on year, also as expected.

squawks.headline: UK manufacturing output rises 0.7% in September against a forecast 0.5% fall; industrial production up 0.3%
squawks.detail: ONS data show September industrial production rose 0.3% on the month against a forecast -0.4%, and manufacturing rose 4.4% year on year against a 3.8% forecast. Construction output rose 0.8% on the month against a forecast 0.0%.

squawks.headline: UK GDP grows 0.7% in the third quarter, in line with forecasts, while monthly GDP rises 0.2% against an expected 0%
squawks.detail: The preliminary estimate shows annual growth of 1.9%, matching forecasts, up from 0.5% quarterly and 1.4% annual growth previously; services rose 0.2% on the month against a forecast of 0%. Construction output rose 0.8% month on month (forecast -0.1%), industrial production grew 3.1% year on year (forecast 2.8%) and business investment rose 0.43% quarter on quarter (forecast 0.6%, previous 1.8%).

squawks.headline: Iran's IRGC Navy claims two supertankers exploded in the Strait of Hormuz overnight
squawks.detail: Sepah News, the IRGC's news outlet, reports the IRGC Navy's claim that two supertankers exploded in the Strait of Hormuz overnight. The claim has not been independently confirmed, and no market reaction has been reported.

squawks.headline: Chinese and UK trade ministers discuss electric vehicles, China's commerce ministry says
squawks.detail: China's Commerce Ministry said its trade minister and the UK trade minister exchanged views on electric vehicles. It gave no details of any outcome.

squawks.headline: EU leaders aim to agree Hernández de Cos as next ECB president as soon as this month, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports growing support for the Spanish economist Pablo Hernández de Cos's bid to become president of the European Central Bank. It says EU leaders want to seal a deal as early as November.

squawks.headline: BoJ's Asada puts Japan's neutral rate near the low end of the staff range and says any further hikes should come slowly
squawks.detail: BoJ board member Asada said no terminal rate target has been set, that rate rises could weaken underlying inflation as consumption slows, and that a rate cut is not under consideration. He said he is not wholly opposed to hikes and that rates may need to rise gradually at some point. He also said the neutral rate may be somewhat above the current policy rate.

squawks.headline: Russia's diesel exports double after US sanctions relief, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Russian diesel exports have doubled following US sanctions relief, with none of the supply going to the US.

squawks.headline: France backs Spain's Hernandez de Cos as candidate for ECB president, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that France has signalled its support for Spain's candidate, Pablo Hernandez de Cos, for the presidency of the European Central Bank.

squawks.headline: EU and UK set to postpone a planned 10% tariff on electric vehicles, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that the EU and the UK plan to delay a 10% tariff on electric cars. European carmakers had warned that the levy would leave them more exposed to Chinese competition.

squawks.headline: China's central bank signals more room for monetary easing as growth holds up, WSJ reports
squawks.detail: The Wall Street Journal reports that the People's Bank of China has signalled greater scope to ease monetary policy while growth remains firm.

squawks.headline: Dollar reaches a 19-month high as markets price further Fed tightening and the yen weakens
squawks.detail: The dollar rose to its strongest level in 19 months in Asian trade on bets on further Federal Reserve tightening. Asian currencies came under renewed pressure, and the New Zealand dollar fell as traders weighed a bigger Fed rate rise.

squawks.headline: Japan's 5-year government bond yield falls 2bp to 2.170%
squawks.detail: The 5-year JGB yield fell 2bp to 2.170% in Asian trade, after BoJ board member Asada's remarks urging caution on rate rises.

squawks.headline: BoJ's Asada says Japan's inflation is not necessarily demand-led and that consumption data may be weaker than they look
squawks.detail: BoJ board member Asada said any further rate rises must come at a cautious pace and that policy takes at least a year to feed through to borrowing. He expects Japan's growth to pick up moderately.

squawks.headline: Brent and WTI crude fall $1 a barrel on Middle East peace optimism
squawks.detail: Brent and WTI crude oil were both reported $1 a barrel lower in Asian trading, with the fall attributed to optimism over peace in the Middle East.

squawks.headline: BoJ's Asada urges caution on further rate rises, saying hikes from a neutral policy rate could hit the economy harder
squawks.detail: Bank of Japan board member Asada said financial conditions remain accommodative and underlying inflation is around levels consistent with the 2% target. She said the BoJ must be cautious about the pace of any future increases and can use consumer price data to judge the risk of inflation overshooting.

squawks.headline: US 2-year Treasury yield rises nearly 5bp to a two-week high of 4.7756%
squawks.detail: The US 2-year Treasury yield reached a two-week high in Asian trading, while the 10-year yield was reported steady at 4.99%. Gold prices were reported under pressure from rising expectations of Fed rate hikes.

squawks.headline: Japan's top currency official Mimura says currency moves are too rapid
squawks.detail: Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs commented on the speed of moves in the currency market. The dollar was trading near 159.55 yen after recent gains.

squawks.headline: Fed's Goolsbee calls the latest US inflation report borderline disturbing
squawks.detail: The Chicago Fed president's remarks came as hot US inflation data and hawkish Fed comments raised expectations of a rate hike in December. Gold fell 0.8% to $4,002.54 an ounce and the dollar index was reported up 0.4%.

squawks.headline: UK RICS house price balance falls to -36 in October, weaker than the -33.5 forecast
squawks.detail: The RICS housing survey balance came in at -36, compared with a forecast of -33.5 and -32 the previous month.

squawks.headline: US and China agree leader-level talks matter, including a possible trilateral summit with Russia
squawks.detail: The US State Department said Secretary of State Rubio and China's Wang Yi agreed on the importance of leader-level talks to advance peace and denuclearisation, including a potential trilateral summit with Russia.

squawks.headline: Japan's producer prices rise 7.1% year on year in October, above the 6.5% forecast
squawks.detail: BoJ data show the corporate goods price index rose 7.1% year on year, against a 6.5% forecast and 6.8% previously, and 0.7% month on month against a 0.3% forecast. In early trade, benchmark 10-year JGB futures were reported up 0.03 point.

squawks.headline: Markets price 76bp of Fed hikes through June 2027, up from 72bp at Tuesday's close
squawks.detail: Fed pricing moved further in the hawkish direction after the hot US CPI print. Gold is reported to be falling and all G10 currencies are down against the dollar.

squawks.headline: German coalition agrees 2027 budget and drops planned electricity tax cut, Spiegel reports
squawks.detail: Spiegel reports that Germany's governing coalition has agreed its 2027 budget and that a planned cut to electricity tax is not in it.

squawks.headline: Iranian general Heydari says Strait of Hormuz is closed and will reopen only on the Supreme Leader's order
squawks.detail: Brigadier General Heydari said Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz and will not reopen it unless the leader of the revolution orders it, the ISNA news agency reported. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Trade-weighted dollar rises sharply on hawkish Fed bets after hot US CPI and Waller's mention of a 50bp hike
squawks.detail: An economist reports a big rise in the trade-weighted dollar on Wednesday, driven by rate differentials, as markets digest Tuesday's hot US CPI data and Fed Governor Waller's talk of a 50bp rate hike next month.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Ukraine aims to get results from the peace talks by the end of the year
squawks.detail: Speaking in Dublin, Ukrainian President Zelenskiy said Kyiv wants the peace talks to produce results by year end and will do everything it can to achieve that.

squawks.headline: US asks Russia to put forward a new European security proposal, Axios reports
squawks.detail: Axios reports that the US has asked Russia to submit a new proposal on European security, following the US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: Dollar hits a session high against the Swiss franc, up 0.98% at 0.83325
squawks.detail: A market commentator reported that the dollar reached a session high against the Swiss franc and was last up 0.98% at 0.83325 francs.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Russian envoys have rejected ceasefire proposals
squawks.detail: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy said Russia's negotiators turned down proposals for a ceasefire. The statement follows the US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey says the Treasury is discussing worst-case energy support for UK households, FT reports
squawks.detail: The FT reports that Chancellor Rachel Healey is preparing for a deepening energy crisis, with the Treasury discussing worst-case support for households. No cost or details of the support were given.

squawks.headline: BoE's Greene says UK labour market has less slack than thought and data show wage growth is too high
squawks.detail: MPC member Megan Greene made the remarks in comments reported by the FT, in which she also repeated her support for tightening monetary policy proactively.

squawks.headline: Houthis claim cruise missile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid airport and a drone strike on a pumping station in Saudi Arabia's Yanbu region
squawks.detail: Yemen's Houthis said they fired three cruise missiles at King Khalid airport in Riyadh and attacked a pumping station in the Yanbu region with a drone. Saudi Arabia had earlier reportedly said it intercepted three Houthi cruise missiles over Riyadh; no market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: BoE's Green backs tightening policy proactively to guard against wage growth staying high, FT reports
squawks.detail: Bank of England MPC member Megan Green said it is right to tighten the monetary policy stance proactively to lean against the risk that wage growth stays at higher levels, according to the Financial Times.

squawks.headline: US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi end with a prisoner swap but without a breakthrough, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that the Abu Dhabi talks, the first in about nine months after a pause caused by the war in Iran, ended with an agreed prisoner exchange but no breakthrough.

squawks.headline: Fed official warns an Anthropic IPO could set off a large market correction, Semafor reports
squawks.detail: Semafor reported the warning from a Federal Reserve official. The post did not name the official or give further detail.

squawks.headline: Brazil central bank chief Galipolo calls the external environment adverse and urges emerging markets to take extra care
squawks.detail: Galipolo said growing global demand for capital is putting pressure on interest rates, and that the short end of the yield curve is more sensitive to currency volatility. He also said there had been no debate at the central bank about changing the inflation-targeting regime, and that calls for lower rates are normal when growth slows while inflation picks up.

squawks.headline: Iran attacks ship navigation systems on Oman's Didamar island in the Strait of Hormuz, sources say
squawks.detail: Reuters cites three sources with knowledge of the matter as confirming that Iran attacked shipping navigation systems on the Omani island, which is infrastructure used to restore Gulf oil flows. No market reaction was reported in the posts.

squawks.headline: US seeks to close Iran's land borders to tighten blockade, but neighbouring states push back, NYT reports
squawks.detail: The New York Times reports that Washington wants to step up economic pressure on Iran by sealing its land borders. Neighbouring countries are resisting because they fear the economic fallout.

squawks.headline: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf warns Trump he would be defeated if he returns to war, and says the US must decide
squawks.detail: Iranian reports quote parliament speaker Ghalibaf as saying it is now up to the US to decide whether talks continue, which requires it to meet Iran's seven conditions. He also said Trump would face defeat if he chose to go to war again.

squawks.headline: Trump declares US victory in Iran and says it will take Iran 25 years to rebuild its losses
squawks.detail: US President Trump said the US had won in Iran and that rebuilding what Iran had lost would take 25 years. He also said the US was more respected than ever.

squawks.headline: Trump says Iran will never be allowed to have a nuclear weapon
squawks.detail: US President Trump repeated that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, as talks continue on reopening Hormuz and on direct Iran-US talks. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Ukraine's military says it struck Russia's Baltic oil port of Ust-Luga, damaging storage tanks
squawks.detail: Ukraine's military said it carried out a strike on the Russian Baltic port of Ust-Luga and that tanks at the port were damaged. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Sterling falls against a stronger dollar as markets bet on a Fed rate hike next month
squawks.detail: Reuters reports the pound fell against the dollar on Wednesday. The dollar strengthened across the board after US inflation data and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials the day before raised bets on a Fed hike next month.

squawks.headline: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf says Iran and Oman have agreed a Hormuz shipping lane and traffic separation arrangement
squawks.detail: In an interview with Al Jazeera, Ghalibaf said Iran had reached an understanding with Oman on the shipping route and traffic separation system in the Strait of Hormuz, but that the strait will not go back to how it was before the war because this is one of Iran's seven conditions. He also said Iran does not want the war to go on but its demands must be met, and offered to help Saudi Arabia and the Houthis settle their differences if asked.

squawks.headline: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf says US envoys asked Putin to help set up direct Iran-US talks
squawks.detail: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf said US officials who travelled to Russia asked Putin to speak to Iran about holding direct talks between Tehran and Washington, according to Fars News. Iranian reports also quoted him as saying Trump would be defeated again if he returned to war.

squawks.headline: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf says US must meet all seven of Iran's conditions before Hormuz reopens and talks resume
squawks.detail: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said Washington has not yet formally answered Iran's message and plan, and that the decision now rests with the US, Al Jazeera reported. He said the Strait of Hormuz will reopen and talks will resume only once the US fully implements Iran's seven conditions.

squawks.headline: Saudi Arabia reportedly says it intercepted three Houthi cruise missiles over Riyadh
squawks.detail: Reports say Saudi Arabia intercepted three cruise missiles launched by the Houthis over its capital, Riyadh. No market reaction was reported in the inputs.

squawks.headline: Brent crude adds to gains and is up $3 a barrel amid uncertainty over the Iran and Ukraine talks
squawks.detail: Oil futures extended their rise, with Brent up $3 a barrel, from the earlier $2 gain. Reports linked the move to uncertainty over talks on Iran and Ukraine.

squawks.headline: Fed officials reportedly split over whether New York Fed President Williams should leave in 2027 or 2028
squawks.detail: Sources say there is an internal Federal Reserve debate over the timing of New York Fed President John Williams' departure, with 2027 and 2028 both under consideration. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner says Russia and Ukraine have reached an important breakthrough in the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: US envoy Kushner described the Abu Dhabi talks as serious and frank and said Russia and Ukraine had achieved an important breakthrough, according to reports.

squawks.headline: Brent crude extends gains, up $2 a barrel amid uncertainty over talks to end the Iran and Ukraine wars
squawks.detail: Oil futures extended their rise, with Brent reported up $2 a barrel, citing uncertainty over negotiations to end the wars in Iran and Ukraine.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator Medinsky says a fair security system from the talks would secure peace in Europe for decades
squawks.detail: Medinsky made the remarks after the Abu Dhabi talks on a Ukraine settlement, according to reports from Russia. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey says fiscal headroom should be used when needed and rebuilt when possible
squawks.detail: UK Chancellor Healey set out her approach to fiscal headroom: draw on it when it is needed and restore it when conditions allow. The post gave no figures.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator Medinsky rules out territorial swaps with Ukraine and says the border security zone will keep growing
squawks.detail: TASS and Vesti report that Medinsky said Russia sees no possibility of territorial exchanges with Ukraine. He also said the security zone along the border is substantial and will expand further, and that a fair security system could secure peace in Europe for decades.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey says an end to the Middle East war would be the biggest single economic gain for the UK
squawks.detail: UK Chancellor Rachel Healey made the remarks on Wednesday, according to a market news account. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: China's Wang Yi and US Secretary of State Rubio hold phone call that Xinhua calls positive and constructive
squawks.detail: According to Xinhua, China's Foreign Minister said Beijing is willing to step up communication and cooperation with the US and to handle differences and sensitive issues properly. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Large-scale attack on Russia's Omsk refinery, the country's largest, sets off a fire, reports say
squawks.detail: Unconfirmed reports say explosions have been heard at the Omsk Oil Refinery for more than two hours and the strikes have caused a fire at the site. The reports do not mention any market reaction.

squawks.headline: Kremlin says no Putin-Trump conversation is currently planned after the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: Kremlin spokesman Peskov said no conversation between Putin and Trump is planned at present following the three-way talks between delegations in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: Russian foreign ministry says Russia has no plans to attack Europe
squawks.detail: Russia's foreign ministry made the statement on 11 November, as US-brokered talks on a Ukraine settlement continue. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey says the UK economy is proving resilient and she aims to beat growth forecasts next year
squawks.detail: UK Chancellor Rachel Healey said the UK economy is showing real resilience. She also said she aims to beat next year's growth forecasts.

squawks.headline: Kremlin aide Ushakov calls Abu Dhabi talks substantial and says a Putin-Trump meeting at APEC is being prepared
squawks.detail: Kremlin foreign policy aide Yuri Ushakov called the Abu Dhabi talks substantial and very useful, and said European-format talks will assess their outcome, Russian agencies report. The Kremlin also said a Putin-Trump meeting at APEC is being prepared.

squawks.headline: Iran's Rezaei says Tehran will target US bases in European countries if US aircraft use them to strike Iran
squawks.detail: Iranian senior official Mohsen Rezaei made the warning and separately said Putin told him he had stressed to the US that Iran cannot be overthrown. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Euro falls to its lowest against the dollar since May 2025, down 0.61% at $1.1097
squawks.detail: A market news account reported the euro last down 0.61% at $1.1097 against the US dollar, its weakest level since May 2025.

squawks.headline: German economic advisers urge Merz to fund defence from the regular budget to keep debt from reaching 98% of GDP by 2040
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Germany's Council of Economic Experts wants military spending moved gradually onto the regular budget. The panel warns that otherwise debt could reach 98% of GDP by 2040.

squawks.headline: Saudi oil output recovers to above its average before the Iran conflict, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Saudi Arabia's crude production has rebounded to near prewar levels and is above its average before the Iran conflict. The kingdom has kept exports moving despite attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator Medinsky says the sides have moved closer to peace after the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: Russia's top Ukraine negotiator Medinsky said the parties appear closer to peace following the three-way negotiations in Abu Dhabi, according to Interfax reports.

squawks.headline: Dollar extends gains against the yen, up 0.5% at 159.55
squawks.detail: A market newswire reports the dollar up 0.5% at 159.55 yen. Earlier in the session it was up 0.2% at 159.04.

squawks.headline: Lavrov says Putin will decide next steps on Ukraine after US envoys Witkoff and Kushner brief him in Moscow
squawks.detail: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said US envoys Witkoff and Kushner will brief President Putin in Moscow, after which Putin will determine the further course of action, according to reports.

squawks.headline: German Council of Economic Experts forecasts growth of 1.3% in 2026 and 1% in 2027, flags defence borrowing strain
squawks.detail: Germany's Council of Economic Experts projects GDP growth of 1.3% in 2026 and 1% in 2027. The panel also warns that defence-related borrowing is putting pressure on the public finances.

squawks.headline: German Council of Economic Experts forecasts inflation at 2.8% in 2026 and 3.3% in 2027
squawks.detail: Germany's Council of Economic Experts projects inflation of 2.8% for 2026, rising to 3.3% in 2027.

squawks.headline: German government says any Putin-Merz talks could build on principles agreed in Abu Dhabi
squawks.detail: The German government said possible talks between Russian President Putin and Chancellor Merz could go ahead based on the principles agreed at the Abu Dhabi Ukraine talks.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy calls for Europe to join Ukraine negotiations and for a firm US position in the peace talks
squawks.detail: Ukraine's president said Europe should take part in the negotiations and that Kyiv needs the US to take a strong stance in the peace talks. The remarks follow the three-way talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: German government says it is waiting for Russia to respond to proposals for future Ukraine talks
squawks.detail: A German government spokesperson said Berlin is awaiting Russia's reaction to the proposals for future Ukraine talks. The spokesperson added that the US has as much interest as Europe in a peaceful settlement for Ukraine.

squawks.headline: German government says a proposal exists for Europeans to take part in future Ukraine talks
squawks.detail: A German government spokesperson said Europe's involvement in several formats at the Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine had paid off. The spokesperson added that agreements could not be put into effect without consensus among NATO members.

squawks.headline: OPEC+ crude output rises 2.04m bpd to 41.23m bpd in October as Saudi output jumps to 10.563m bpd
squawks.detail: OPEC's monthly report puts OPEC+ crude production, including former member UAE, at an average 41.23 million bpd in October, up 2.04 million bpd from September. Saudi Arabia told OPEC it produced 10.563 million bpd in October, up 26% from 8.372 million bpd in September, and the rise was reported as a new wartime high.

squawks.headline: OPEC keeps its 2026 and 2027 global oil demand growth forecasts unchanged in its monthly report
squawks.detail: OPEC's monthly oil market report leaves its world oil demand growth projections for 2026 and 2027 unchanged.

squawks.headline: G7 foreign ministers condemn North Korean, Iranian and Chinese support for Russia's military, UK reports
squawks.detail: According to the UK, the G7 foreign ministers' statement condemns North Korea and Iran for giving military assistance to Russia, and China for supplying weapons, military training and dual-use components. The ministers also express grave concern over Iranian involvement in violent plots, including one against the UK's RAF Fairford base.

squawks.headline: German finance minister says Germany's AAA credit rating is not under threat
squawks.detail: Germany's finance minister said the country's top AAA sovereign rating is not in danger, after Chancellor Merz said Germany must do everything it can to keep the rating.

squawks.headline: UK PM Burnham says an EU deal could lift UK GDP by 0.4%
squawks.detail: Prime Minister Burnham gave the estimate of an EU deal's potential effect on UK GDP in remarks reported on Wednesday. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap to be the largest yet, with more than 1,000 people on each side
squawks.detail: A Russian official, General Zorin, gave the figure for the exchange agreed at the Abu Dhabi talks.

squawks.headline: UK PM Burnham says he will set out a plan for the UK before the Christmas recess
squawks.detail: The Prime Minister made the pledge while taking questions in parliament on 11 November. He gave no further details of the plan's content.

squawks.headline: ECB's Makhlouf says price pressures sit mainly in energy but upside inflation risks persist
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Gabriel Makhlouf said price pressures were largely limited to energy and that upside risks to inflation remain. He added that financing conditions have tightened following the rise in yields.

squawks.headline: Kremlin says Putin is open to contacts with European leaders including Merz and that dialogue with the US will continue
squawks.detail: Kremlin spokesman Peskov said Putin has not yet received a full report on the Abu Dhabi talks and will meet Russian negotiators if he deems it necessary. He said no decision has been made on Putin attending the G20 summit in Miami.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator Medinsky says all Russian land will be returned by one means or another
squawks.detail: Russian presidential aide and chief negotiator Vladimir Medinsky made the remark on territory after the three-way Russia-US-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended. The post reported no market reaction.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner backs a Putin-Zelenskiy meeting and says he and Witkoff go to Moscow tomorrow
squawks.detail: After the Abu Dhabi talks on a Ukraine settlement, US envoy Kushner said a meeting between Zelenskiy and Putin would be welcome. He also said he and fellow envoy Witkoff will travel to Moscow tomorrow. Separate reports say the Russian delegation leaves the UAE for Moscow today.

squawks.headline: Ukrainian negotiator says Kyiv heard no ultimatums from either side at the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: Ukrainian negotiator Serhii Kyslytsya said no side issued ultimatums during the three-way talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner says Europe should name one negotiator and that Russia wants more progress before a Putin-Zelenskiy meeting
squawks.detail: US envoy Kushner said talks with the EU and NATO went very well, that Europeans are needed at the table for post-war security talks, and that the two sides do not trust each other but should be guided by their interests. He said he and Witkoff will travel to Moscow on Thursday to discuss a prisoner exchange.

squawks.headline: Ukrainian negotiators see momentum towards a settlement before year-end and call for multilateral talks that include Europe
squawks.detail: After the Abu Dhabi talks, Ukrainian negotiators said a solution before the end of the year was possible and reported major progress on European security. They also said the talks should be multilateral rather than three-way and that Russia's delegation had arrived with strict instructions, which made discussions difficult.

squawks.headline: Russia's deputy foreign minister Ryabkov says Abu Dhabi meetings have laid groundwork for further work
squawks.detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said the Abu Dhabi talks on a Ukraine settlement had laid a foundation for further work.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner reports good progress on Ukraine security guarantees but says territory will be the hardest issue to settle
squawks.detail: Speaking at a joint US-Ukrainian press conference after the Abu Dhabi talks, Kushner said no post-war security agreement will happen without a deal on territory, and that the US is trying to bring the Europeans into the talks. He also said the numbers for the agreed prisoner swap will be finalised tomorrow, and that he and Witkoff will meet Putin in Moscow tomorrow.

squawks.headline: German Chancellor Merz says Germany must do everything it can to keep its AAA credit rating
squawks.detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Germany must do all it can to preserve its AAA credit rating.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator praises US envoys and says Europe can join the Ukraine peace process only once it changes its stance
squawks.detail: Russia's chief negotiator Medinsky said European security architecture was the central topic at the Abu Dhabi talks, described the US envoys as constructive, and said Europe had made no proposals. He said details would not be made public until agreements are reached.

squawks.headline: Russia's chief negotiator says Abu Dhabi talks will continue, with a large prisoner exchange agreed with Ukraine
squawks.detail: After the three-way talks in Abu Dhabi ended, Russia's chief negotiator Vladimir Medinsky said the sides agreed on some issues but not others, and that European security was the main topic. He said Russia and Ukraine had agreed a new large-scale exchange of prisoners of war and that Russia had received no peace proposal from the EU.

squawks.headline: Germany's Council of Economic Experts chair says the panel's growth forecasts will rise significantly
squawks.detail: Monika Schnitzer, chair of Germany's Council of Economic Experts, said the panel's economic forecasts would be raised significantly. She said the recovery from the oil price surge caused by the Iran war had come sooner than expected.

squawks.headline: Portugal's final October CPI confirms 3.8% annual inflation, with the harmonised measure at 3.9%
squawks.detail: Portugal's statistics office INE confirmed the flash reading of 3.8% annual inflation for October and 0.2% on the month. The harmonised index rose 3.9% on the year and was unchanged on the month.

squawks.headline: Ireland's final October CPI shows 4.3% annual inflation, with the harmonised measure at 4.2%
squawks.detail: Final October figures put Ireland's consumer price inflation at 4.3% year on year and the harmonised index at 4.2% year on year.

squawks.headline: Bank of Mauritius sets its repo rate at 5%
squawks.detail: The Bank of Mauritius has announced its policy decision, setting the repo rate at 5%. The post did not say whether the rate had changed.

squawks.headline: German 30-year Bund auction draws 1.297 bid-to-cover, down from 1.4, with yield at 3.66%
squawks.detail: Germany's 30-year Bund auction had a bid-to-cover ratio of 1.297, down from 1.4 at the previous sale. The yield was 3.66%, against 3.8% last time.

squawks.headline: Three-way Russia-US-Ukraine talks on a Ukraine settlement conclude in Abu Dhabi
squawks.detail: Reports citing a source and Russian media say the round of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi has ended. The second day of talks lasted almost two hours.

squawks.headline: Iran's IRGC says two tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz overnight
squawks.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz overnight, Iran's Fars news agency reports.

squawks.headline: Dollar rises 0.2% to 159.04 yen, its highest since 24 September
squawks.detail: USD/JPY gains 0.2% to 159.04, reaching its highest level since 24 September.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy welcomes the US decision to include Europe in the Abu Dhabi peace talks
squawks.detail: Ukraine's president says he welcomes the US move to bring Europe into the Abu Dhabi talks on ending the war.

squawks.headline: PBOC says Chinese loan rates are already relatively low and expects prices to grow at a reasonable pace
squawks.detail: China's central bank says lending rates in China are already fairly low and that it expects reasonable growth in prices.

squawks.headline: PBOC's third-quarter policy report pledges more support for domestic demand and action against an exchange rate overshoot
squawks.detail: China's central bank published its monetary policy implementation report for the third quarter. It describes the external environment as more complex and volatile and global growth as lacking resilience, and says it will use and adjust its policy tools at the appropriate time.

squawks.headline: Kremlin says Russia has no plans for contacts with the EU delegation at the Abu Dhabi talks and has held no such meetings
squawks.detail: The Kremlin also said Russia and the EU effectively have no relations at present, and that the Russian delegation has kept President Putin briefed throughout the Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine.

squawks.headline: Goldman Sachs adds a 25bp Fed rate rise in March to its outlook after hotter-than-expected US October inflation
squawks.detail: Reuters reports that Goldman Sachs now expects a 25bp Federal Reserve rate rise in March. It made the change on Tuesday after US October inflation came in above expectations, dropping its earlier call that the hiking cycle would end in December.

squawks.headline: Iran warns any US attack would trigger strikes on distant US bases
squawks.detail: A wire-style headline reports an Iranian warning that it would answer a US attack by striking US bases far from Iran. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Iran's security chief says Tehran will not let any enriched nuclear material leave the country
squawks.detail: Iran's security chief Rezaei made the remarks in an exchange with a Lebanese official, according to a newswire headline, and Al Mayadeen separately reported that Iran will not remove enriched material from the country. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Belgium joins France as investors target weaker eurozone credits over debt and deficits, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that investors are paying renewed attention to fiscal and political risks and are increasingly targeting the eurozone's weaker credits, now including Belgium alongside France, over debt and deficit concerns.

squawks.headline: Japan PM Takaichi says the government is coordinating with the BoJ under their existing joint statement
squawks.detail: Japan's prime minister said the government will work with the Bank of Japan towards price stability and economic growth, as set out in the existing joint statement.

squawks.headline: Italian industrial production rises 1.2% on the month, above the 0.7% forecast
squawks.detail: Italy's monthly industrial production rose 1.2%, against a forecast of 0.7%, after falling 1.3% in the previous month.

squawks.headline: Banks use credit insurance to free up lending capacity as they hit limits on exposure to the AI boom, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Barclays, HSBC and JPMorgan Chase are among the lenders exploring or using credit insurance to free up capacity after reaching limits on lending to AI.

squawks.headline: ECB's Nagel says Germany's recovery is beating forecasts and expects growth to pick up in Q4
squawks.detail: Bundesbank President and ECB Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said the German economic recovery has been stronger than forecast. He said growth is likely to accelerate in the fourth quarter.

squawks.headline: German final HICP confirms annual inflation at 2.8%, in line with forecasts
squawks.detail: Final German HICP shows 2.8% year on year and -0.1% month on month, both matching forecasts and the previous readings. Final German CPI shows -0.2% month on month, also as expected.

squawks.headline: UK government backs approval of two major offshore wind projects with £1bn from the National Wealth Fund
squawks.detail: The UK government welcomed the approval of two large offshore wind projects. It confirmed a £12bn investment announcement by RWE and KKR, with £1bn of the financing package coming from the National Wealth Fund. It said more than 2,400 jobs would be supported during construction and operation.

squawks.headline: Japan's 10-year JGB yield extends rise to 2.795%, up 10.5bp, as longer maturities also climb
squawks.detail: Market reports put the 10-year JGB yield at 2.795%, up 10.5bp on the day. The 30-year yield rose 6.5bp to 3.935% and the 40-year rose 4bp to 4.100%.

squawks.headline: Oil rebounds from a two-month low as attacks on Hormuz shipping offset hopes of an Iran truce
squawks.detail: Reuters reports oil prices rose on Wednesday after falling to two-month lows in the previous session. It says traders were weighing hopes of de-escalation in the Iran war against continuing attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

squawks.headline: Japan's 10-year JGB yield rises 9bp to 2.780% and 5-year climbs 8.5bp to 2.185%
squawks.detail: The 10-year JGB yield extended its rise to 2.780%, up 9bp, after the 5-year yield earlier gained 8.5bp to 2.185%. Asian bond yields rose as bets on a Federal Reserve rate increase grew.

squawks.headline: Global bonds fall and dollar holds firm as hot US inflation raises risk of a half-point Fed hike
squawks.detail: Reuters reports that global bonds fell sharply after a hot US inflation print and hawkish central bank comments raised the chance of a half-point Federal Reserve rate rise next month. Equities held up and the dollar stayed firm.

squawks.headline: Japan PM Takaichi rules out fiscal measures that risk high inflation and expects BoJ to secure 2% goal
squawks.detail: Japan's Prime Minister said the government has no intention of adopting fiscal policies that could push inflation excessively higher. She said she expects the Bank of Japan to set suitable policy to reach its 2% inflation target sustainably.

squawks.headline: Rubio tells G7 counterparts Trump has opted to pressure Iran's regime rather than go to war or strike a deal
squawks.detail: Axios reports that the US Secretary of State told G7 peers the president has chosen a policy of pressure on Iran's government instead of either military action or an agreement.

squawks.headline: Japan's 10-year JGB yield rises 6.5bp to 2.755% and 2-year climbs 7bp to 1.845%
squawks.detail: Japanese government bond yields rose in early Tokyo trade, with the 10-year up 6.5bp at 2.755% and the 2-year up 7bp at 1.845%. Earlier in the session, 10-year JGB futures fell 0.56 point.

squawks.headline: UK investigation into the Budget leak covers details of bank tax measures
squawks.detail: British authorities are reported to be investigating a leak of Budget details on bank taxes. This adds to the earlier report that a government security group was looking into a possible leak of Budget measures.

squawks.headline: Fed's Paulson puts underlying US inflation at 2.5% to 3% and says policy must stay somewhat tight
squawks.detail: Fed official Paulson said the US economy has been more resilient than expected, with a firm and steady job market, and that the Fed has more work to do on inflation. She said the effect of AI and energy on inflation is difficult to measure and that the path of rates will depend on economic developments.

squawks.headline: NIESR calls on the Bank of England to raise rates from 4% to 5% and says inflation may not reach 2% target until 2030
squawks.detail: In its autumn report, the National Institute of Economic and Social Research says the Bank should raise Bank Rate sharply to 5% from 4%. It also says inflation may not return to the 2% target until 2030.

squawks.headline: Fed's Goolsbee says the US faces a genuine inflation challenge and all policy options remain open
squawks.detail: Speaking on PBS NewsHour, Fed official Goolsbee calls the CPI report borderline troubling and says his biggest concerns are high services inflation and emerging widespread overheating in prices. He says the Fed must bring inflation back to target and that the job market remains steady.

squawks.headline: Fed's Paulson backs further gradual rate rises and says CPI data show inflation is still a problem
squawks.detail: Fed official Paulson says policy must stay somewhat tight, the Fed has more work to do, and underlying inflation remains between 2.5% and 3%. He calls the economy more resilient than expected, with a firm and steady job market, and says he backed recent rate moves.

squawks.headline: Oil falls to $90 a barrel on hopes that talks will end the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine
squawks.detail: Semafor reports that oil fell to $90 a barrel after US President Trump played down the risk of renewed conflict with Iran and talks between Kyiv, Moscow and Washington began.

squawks.headline: Poland's Orlen ends a long-term LNG supply contract with QatarEnergy, citing ongoing force majeure
squawks.detail: Orlen, Poland's largest energy group, said on Tuesday it had terminated one of its two long-term LNG supply contracts with QatarEnergy. It said an ongoing force majeure had left the supplier unable to meet its delivery obligations.

squawks.headline: UK ministers reject Botley West, which would have been Britain's largest solar farm
squawks.detail: The UK government turned down the Oxfordshire project, saying it would do substantial harm to the green belt and to Blenheim Palace, the FT reports.

squawks.headline: US Senate advances permitting reform bill meant to speed up building of energy infrastructure
squawks.detail: Semafor reports that the US Senate has moved forward major permitting reforms designed to speed up construction of energy infrastructure. The outlet says the Democrats' win in last week's midterms has added momentum to the reform.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman says inflation is not trending lower and the Fed must consider the pace and timeline of its response
squawks.detail: Fed Governor Bowman said that inflation not moving down should give policymakers pause. She added that the Fed needs to weigh how fast to act on it and over what timeline.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman likens possible action on inflation in coming months to last year's gradual cuts followed by a pause
squawks.detail: Federal Reserve Governor Bowman said the Fed cut rates gradually last year, paused and then resumed, and that it may take a similar approach to addressing inflation in the coming months.

squawks.headline: Fed's Waller warns a half-point rate rise in December may be necessary
squawks.detail: Waller's warning came on the same day Fed's Logan backed at least two more quarter-point rises, after a stronger-than-expected US CPI print. Market wraps report that US stocks and Treasuries fell, with short-dated Treasuries hit hardest, while the dollar rose and money markets priced in a December move larger than 25bp.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman says AI will raise worker productivity, create new jobs and remove less essential ones
squawks.detail: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman commented on the labour market effects of artificial intelligence in remarks on Tuesday.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman says the Fed is collecting data on AI debt counterparties and stresses open communication with the Treasury
squawks.detail: Federal Reserve Governor Bowman said the Fed is seeking data on counterparties to AI-related debt, and that keeping lines of communication open with the US Treasury is critically important.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman says she would need AI and Middle East risks to ease before being confident inflation falls next year
squawks.detail: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman said she is shifting her focus to inflation and that longer-term inflation expectations remain very well anchored. She added that expectations are an important input but do not necessarily drive her thinking.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy welcomes recent US messages and sees a change in approach from envoys Witkoff and Kushner
squawks.detail: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy, speaking in Copenhagen, said he was very pleased with recent messages from the US side and saw changes in the approach of US envoys Witkoff and Kushner. The remarks follow the Abu Dhabi talks on ending the war.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says a new European security architecture is on the agenda at the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy, speaking in Copenhagen, said a new European security architecture is among the topics in the Abu Dhabi talks on ending the war.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman estimates October core PCE at 3.3% and says the Fed must weigh the costs of further tightening as financial conditions tighten
squawks.detail: In a speech to the Council on Foreign Relations, Federal Reserve Governor Bowman said core PCE probably rose 3.3% in October because of energy prices and AI-related demand, and that she expects it to move closer to 2% next year as those shocks unwind. She also said financial conditions have tightened, and that the labour market has improved but is not tight and is not adding to inflation.

squawks.headline: Fed's Bowman says persistent inflation and a firming labour market mean there is still work to do
squawks.detail: Federal Reserve Governor Bowman cited persistent inflation and firmer labour market conditions in her remarks.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Ukraine is ready to discuss territory and to meet Putin, but doubts Russia is ready for a leaders' meeting
squawks.detail: Ukraine's president said Kyiv will request a meeting of leaders and is prepared to talk about territory. He added that Ukraine and Russia discussed a possible prisoner exchange of 1000 for 1000 or 1500 for 1500.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Europe must settle this month who will represent it in Ukraine peace negotiations
squawks.detail: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy said in Copenhagen that a decision on Europe's representative in the negotiations is needed this month. He also said he hopes the US Congress will act more decisively.

squawks.headline: Iran's Fars says the South Pars platform hit by fire produces 14.5m cubic metres of the field's 700m cubic metres of gas
squawks.detail: Iran's Fars news agency gave the output of the platform at the South Pars gas field where a fire was earlier reported to be under control. It put the platform's production at 14.5m cubic metres of gas, out of a field total of 700m cubic metres.

squawks.headline: Fire on a platform at Iran's South Pars gas field is under control, Iranian media report; cause under investigation
squawks.detail: Iran's Fars news agency reports the fire is under control. Iranian reports say the platform produces 14.5m cubic metres of gas out of the field's total 700m, and that a gas leak or an operational incident are the two possible causes.

squawks.headline: Fed's Schmid says US hiring has been fairly robust and demand is strong
squawks.detail: Fed's Schmid said recent US hiring has been fairly robust, demand is strong and interest rates are not holding activity back. He added that a lot of data is due before the Fed's December meeting.

squawks.headline: Fed's Schmid expects instant payments to overtake digital asset structures
squawks.detail: Kansas City Fed President Schmid said instant payment systems are likely to leapfrog digital asset structures. The remarks were about payments, not monetary policy.

squawks.headline: Fed's Schmid says inflation is his main concern
squawks.detail: Kansas City Fed President Jeffrey Schmid said inflation is foremost in his thinking, in further remarks on 10 November.

squawks.headline: Fed's Schmid calls policy rate fairly accommodative and finds no restriction outside housing
squawks.detail: Kansas City Fed President Schmid said US hiring had been quite robust lately and demand was strong. He said rates gave no cause for hesitation, and that apart from the housing market he could find no sign that policy was restrictive.

squawks.headline: US envoy Kushner calls the day's Ukraine talks constructive and says the US is working to end the war
squawks.detail: Kushner said the US was acting at President Trump's direction to end the war and to agree security arrangements for a sovereign Ukraine and lasting peace in Europe.

squawks.headline: Fed's Schmid sees some concerning price trends beneath the energy-driven inflation story
squawks.detail: Kansas City Fed President Jeffrey Schmid said there are some worrying trends in prices underlying the effect of energy. The remarks come on the day US October CPI came in above forecasts.

squawks.headline: Qatar's PM tells G7 foreign ministers Doha has won at least two weeks for diplomacy towards a US-Iran understanding
squawks.detail: According to the Jerusalem Post, Qatari Prime Minister Al Thani told G7 foreign ministers meeting in Paris that Doha had secured a window of at least two weeks to pursue diplomatic efforts between Washington and Tehran.

squawks.headline: Bank of Canada minutes keep further rate hikes on the table and say policy can stop energy prices becoming generalised inflation
squawks.detail: Minutes of the deliberations before the Bank of Canada's 28 October rate announcement show the Governing Council saying uncertainty over rates did not mean inaction, and that rising cost pressures would eventually show up in core inflation. Members also said inflation expectations may have become more sensitive to recent price changes, and that businesses face higher costs for non-energy imports such as semiconductors.

squawks.headline: BoE's Lombardelli sees a case for another rate rise in the near term, citing high energy prices and resilient UK growth
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Bank of England Deputy Governor Clare Lombardelli said high energy prices and the resilience of UK growth support a further rate increase in the near term. She did not rule out back-to-back rate rises.

squawks.headline: US EIA holds 2026 world oil demand at 102.4m bpd, cuts 2027 to 104.4m bpd and trims its 2027 world output forecast
squawks.detail: The US Energy Information Administration's Short-Term Energy Outlook keeps 2026 world oil demand at 102.4m bpd and lowers 2027 to 104.4m bpd from 104.6m bpd. It raises 2026 world oil output to 101.7m bpd from 101.1m bpd and cuts 2027 to 108.4m bpd from 109.6m bpd.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation puts real per-person public services spending growth at 1.7% a year from 2023-24 to 2028-29
squawks.detail: In its Budget analysis, the Resolution Foundation says day-to-day spending is growing moderately in this Parliament. It puts public services spending growth at 1.7% a year in real per-person terms between 2023-24 and 2028-29, which it says is similar to the two most recent periods under Conservative governments.

squawks.headline: New US 10-year notes to carry a 5% coupon, the highest since 2006
squawks.detail: A market commentator reported the coupon after the $42bn US 10-year note auction, which had already been reported as tailing.
